statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. CVEMetadata enriched every :CVE WizFinding. The next statement removes that label, after which CVEMetadata cleanup, which matches :CVE targets, can no longer reach these edges, so delete them first. Scoped to the findings of the Wiz tenant that just completed a full sync, whose findings all link to their WizVulnerability. Idempotent: findings no longer get ENRICHES edges. Each run deletes up to $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE edges from one scan of the tenant, committing every $LIMIT_SIZE, so no pass walks the findings an earlier pass migrated.
statements.query: MATCH (:WizTenant {id: $WIZ_TENANT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:WizFinding:CVE)<-[r:ENRICHES]-(:CVEMetadata) WITH r LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (r) { DELETE r } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases put the :CVE ontology label, with its _ont_* CVE fields, on every WizFinding with a CVE ID. The CVE is now the WizVulnerability the finding links to, and nothing updates these any more, so strip them: left stale, :CVE queries count each Wiz CVE once per affected resource. Idempotent: once stripped, no WizFinding carries :CVE. Batched like the statement above, for the same reason.
statements.query: MATCH (:WizTenant {id: $WIZ_TENANT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:WizFinding:CVE) WITH f LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (f) { REMOVE f:CVE, f._ont_cve_id, f._ont_description, f._ont_base_score, f._ont_base_severity, f._ont_exploitability_score, f._ont_impact_score } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

statements.__comment__: DEPRECATED: temporary backward-compatibility migration; remove in v1.0.0. Earlier releases also wrote the CVE _ont_* fields on vulnerability findings without a CVE, which never carried :CVE. Their WizVulnerability now holds that data and nothing updates these fields any more, so strip them. Idempotent: once stripped, no finding matches. Batched like the statements above.
statements.query: MATCH (:WizTenant {id: $WIZ_TENANT_ID})-[:RESOURCE]->(f:WizFinding:SecurityIssue) WHERE f.finding_type = 'VULNERABILITY' AND (f._ont_description IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_base_score IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_base_severity IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_exploitability_score IS NOT NULL OR f._ont_impact_score IS NOT NULL) WITH f LIMIT $SCAN_LIMIT_SIZE CALL (f) { REMOVE f._ont_description, f._ont_base_score, f._ont_base_severity, f._ont_exploitability_score, f._ont_impact_score } IN TRANSACTIONS OF $LIMIT_SIZE ROWS

name: Wiz - migrate CVE labels written by earlier versions
